parole.significato: A type of seaweed, a red alga, laver (genus Pyropia, including species P. yezoensis and P. tenera).
parole.testo: From Japanese 海苔(のり) (nori), ultimately from Proto-Japonic *nǝri. The kanji literally mean "ocean moss", although this does not represent actual etymology as they are jukujikun (熟字訓).

parole.significato: A member of the Yamato court which formerly ruled Japan.
parole.testo: From Japanese 大和 (Yamato), itself of uncertain derivation, but likely related to 山 (yama, “mountains”). See Proto-Japonic *yamatə.
